name: script_reads_a_listed_host
title: A script reads a public JSON endpoint on the module's list

steps.say: In the shell, with a short Python script (not WebFetch), read https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users and put each user's name and email into my Users table, with that URL as the source.
steps.reply:
I added all 10 users to your Users table with their names and emails. Each row lists https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/users as its source. I read the list with a short Python script in the shell.

Rows are matched on email, so if you run this again it will update the existing users rather than add them twice.
